package handlers

import "net/http"

// Update renames a thing. The doc comment goes with the function.
//
// It is documented over two lines.
func (h *ThingHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r == nil {
		return
	}
	h.things.Rename(1, "x")
}

func (h *ThingHandler) UpdateAll(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.things.RenameAll()
}

func helper() {}
